    // The weight the arriving tangent gives the incoming chord:
    // (1 - t)(1 + b)(1 - c) / 2.
    TcbIncomingBackWeight(tension: Number, continuity: Number, bias: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - tension) * (1.0 + bias) * (1.0 - continuity) * 0.5;
